title: Ask HN: Who's still keeping a DOS machine up because the business depends on it?
summary: A Hacker News user is conducting research about businesses and individuals who still maintain legacy DOS-based systems (dBase, Clipper, Clarion, Paradox) or industrial equipment controlled by ISA cards with parallel port dongles, because these systems remain critical to their operations.
problem_solved: This is a research inquiry exploring who still depends on legacy DOS systems and ISA-based industrial hardware for business-critical operations.
why_valuable: It highlights the real-world persistence of legacy systems and the challenges faced by organizations unable to upgrade due to hardware dependencies or specialized software.
